frameworks.name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v2.0.0

requirements.name: Ensure Security Defaults is enabled on Azure Active Directory
requirements.reason: The directory_security_defaults evaluator tests isEnabled == true.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Multi-Factor Auth Status' is 'Enabled' for all Privileged Users
requirements.reason: The native evaluator checks MFA capability for privileged users. The proposed Conditional Access predicate checks policy coverage, but legacy per-user MFA status and sign-in enforcement remain outside these signals.

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0 paged /users, /identity/conditionalAccess/policies, /reports/authenticationMethods/userRegistrationDetails; paged directory and Azure RBAC role assignments, role definitions, PIM active schedules, transitive group membership; /policies/identitySecurityDefaultsEnforcementPolicy. Resolve named locations, authentication strengths, device filters and sign-in conditions. For CIS 1.1.2 exact legacy status, Graph beta GET /users/{id}/authentication/requirements returns perUserMfaState string; this beta API must be explicitly supported or that status is UNKNOWN.
new_checks.predicate: Report per frozen requirement: for broad MFA requirements, every enabled user (including nonprivileged users and effective Azure resource writers) must have enforced MFA across applicable sign-in contexts after all policy conditions and exclusions are resolved. For CIS 1.1.2 status specifically, each privileged user must have perUserMfaState enabled or enforced; Conditional Access coverage alone does not make the legacy status Enabled. FAIL for a proven uncovered broad-scope context or explicitly disabled legacy status in that requirement. UNKNOWN for uncollected beta status, incomplete users, RBAC/PIM/groups, policy conditions or registration. Empty complete applicable scope is NOT_APPLICABLE.
new_checks.title: MFA covers all enabled users, including privileged and write access users
new_checks.description: Checks effective MFA coverage for all enabled users, with explicit coverage of privileged and Azure resource writers.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Require MFA for every in-scope user, including privileged and Azure resource writers; remove Conditional Access bypasses and verify effective coverage. Where the frozen CIS 1.1.2 legacy status is assessed, set and verify per-user MFA Enabled or Enforced for each privileged user under the organization-approved MFA approach.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Multi-Factor Auth Status' is 'Enabled' for all Non-Privileged Users
requirements.reason: The native evaluator checks MFA capability for non-privileged users. The proposed Conditional Access predicate checks policy coverage, but legacy per-user MFA status and sign-in enforcement remain outside these signals.

new_checks.data_source: Paged Graph users, directory role assignments/definitions and group transitiveMembers identify enabled non-privileged users. GET Graph beta /users/{id}/authentication/requirements supplies perUserMfaState enum disabled/enabled/enforced. Also collect registration details, Conditional Access policies and named locations if evaluating equivalent effective MFA enforcement; resolve every condition and exclusion.
new_checks.predicate: For each enabled non-privileged user, PASS only when perUserMfaState is enabled or enforced and usable MFA registration is present; or when a separately approved equivalence policy and fully resolved Conditional Access evidence prove MFA on every applicable sign-in path. FAIL when a fully measured user has disabled per-user MFA and a known unprotected sign-in path, or is unable to use required MFA. UNKNOWN when per-user state, registration, equivalence policy, role/group scope, CA conditions or pages are unresolved. MFA capability or broad CA policy presence alone cannot PASS the frozen status requirement.
new_checks.title: Require usable MFA for non-privileged users
new_checks.description: Require usable MFA for non-privileged users. A finding is raised when an enabled non-privileged user is not covered by an effective enabled MFA policy or isMfaCapable=false.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access: apply MFA or approved authentication strength to the affected users and sign-in paths; register an allowed strong method.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multi-factor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled
requirements.reason: The exact tenant setting in “Ensure that 'Allow users to remember multi-factor authentication on devices they trust' is Disabled” has no verified read-only field in the frozen Azure collection or a documented API here. Require a dated Entra portal setting screenshot or tenant policy export showing its value.

requirements.name: Ensure Trusted Locations Are Defined
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.entra_trusted_named_location_exists: PASS when an IP named location is trusted and declares a range.

requirements.name: Ensure that an exclusionary Geographic Access Policy is considered
requirements.reason: The proposed policy signal can show an enabled geographic block policy, but the benchmark asks whether exclusionary geographic access was considered. Require a dated risk decision and approved policy or exception for the organization’s locations.

new_checks.data_source: Microsoft Graph GET /identity/conditionalAccess/policies: state,conditions.locations.includeLocations/excludeLocations,conditions.users.includeUsers/excludeUsers,grantControls.builtInControls; GET /identity/conditionalAccess/namedLocations: id,countriesAndRegions; policy input prohibitedCountries Dated organizational risk decision identifying the geographic exclusions considered, affected applications/users and rationale; policy input may explicitly decide no exclusionary geographic block is required.
new_checks.predicate: For each in-scope tenant, assess the frozen requirement to consider an exclusionary geographic Conditional Access policy. PASS only with a current, authorized, documented geographic-access decision covering the relevant users and applications; when the decision requires blocks, also prove the required countries and sign-in paths are blocked by effective enabled policies after all conditions and exclusions. FAIL on a proven missing or expired required review, or a documented blocking requirement with a proven uncovered path. UNKNOWN when review evidence, scope, prohibited-country decision, Graph pages, named-location membership, group resolution or condition semantics is incomplete. An approved decision that no geographic block is warranted can PASS; the mere absence of a prohibited-country list cannot establish FAIL.
new_checks.title: Block sign-ins from prohibited geographic locations
new_checks.description: Assesses configured country block coverage for an explicit prohibited-country list; a policy merely being considered cannot be inferred from the API.
new_checks.remediation_hint: In Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access, create an enabled Block access policy for all users and all cloud apps, including the named locations for prohibited countries; remove unintended exclusions after emergency-account review.

requirements.name: Ensure that A Multi-factor Authentication Policy Exists for Administrative Groups
requirements.reason: The native policy check only detects broad MFA coverage. The proposed predicate tests privileged directory roles specifically; administrative groups outside directory roles remain a manual remainder.

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0 paged Conditional Access policies, users, role assignments and definitions, PIM activation, transitive groups, named locations and authentication strengths; security defaults policy; policy input designated administrative roles/groups and applicable sign-in contexts.
new_checks.predicate: For every enabled effective member of each designated administrative role or group, PASS only when enabled MFA Conditional Access or proven security defaults covers all required cloud apps and client/context combinations after inclusions, exclusions, conditions, grant operator and authentication strength. FAIL for a proven reachable uncovered context. UNKNOWN for missing designated scope, PIM/group resolution, policy conditions, security-default state or pagination. No designated principals is NOT_APPLICABLE only with a complete approved scope.
new_checks.title: Ensure that A Multi-factor Authentication Policy Exists for Administrative Groups
new_checks.description: Measures effective MFA policy coverage for explicitly selected privileged directory roles, including membership and policy exclusions.
new_checks.remediation_hint: In Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access, create enabled MFA or MFA-strength policies for every privileged role; cover all required apps and client types, remove bypass exclusions, and verify effective coverage with What If.

requirements.name: Ensure that A Multi-factor Authentication Policy Exists for All Users
requirements.reason: The native check detects some MFA policy coverage. The proposed predicate requires all users without exclusions; user-specific exceptions and authentication strength need review.

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0 paged /users, /groups and membership, /directoryRoles or role assignments, and /identity/conditionalAccess/policies. Inspect policy state; all user, app, client, location, platform, device, risk and authentication-flow conditions and exclusions; grantControls.operator, builtInControls and authenticationStrength.
new_checks.predicate: For each frozen requirement, use its named user scope: designated users for the older wording and all users where the source says all users. Evaluate each in-scope enabled user against required cloud-app and client-app flows. PASS only if complete user/group/role and Conditional Access pages prove an enforced MFA requirement for every applicable pair after all exclusions and conditions; an OR grant passes only when every alternative requires MFA. FAIL for a definitely uncovered pair. UNKNOWN for unresolved designation, dynamic membership, report-only policies, unmodeled conditions or incomplete inventory.
new_checks.title: Enabled Entra users are covered by MFA policy
new_checks.description: Evaluates effective MFA coverage per user, including exclusions and conditional access scope.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Azure portal > Entra ID > Protection > Conditional Access: create or amend enabled MFA policies covering the uncovered users, apps and client types; inspect all exclusions and What If results.

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Risky Sign-ins
requirements.reason: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Risky Sign-ins is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields.

new_checks.data_source: Microsoft Graph /identity/conditionalAccess/policies: state,conditions.signInRiskLevels,conditions.users,conditions.applications,grantControls; /users id,accountEnabled
new_checks.predicate: For every enabled in-scope user and each medium/high sign-in risk, evaluate all enabled Conditional Access policies together, including user/group/role membership, exclusions, apps, locations, platforms, device filters and client-app conditions. FAIL if a concrete allowed sign-in state has no effective MFA requirement; PASS only if all applicable states are covered and no exclusion bypasses MFA. UNKNOWN if policy inputs, group expansion, risk licensing or condition evaluation is incomplete.
new_checks.title: Require MFA for medium and high risk sign-ins
new_checks.description: Require MFA for medium and high risk sign-ins. A finding is raised when an enabled user lacks effective MFA coverage for both medium and high sign-in risk.
new_checks.remediation_hint: Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access: create or update risk-based policies covering medium and high sign-in risk for all scoped users and apps with Require multifactor authentication; review every exclusion and condition.

requirements.name: Ensure Multi-factor Authentication is Required for Azure Management
requirements.reason: The evaluator finds an enabled MFA Conditional Access policy for the named application, but does not resolve user exclusions, policy grant combinations or effective sign-in enforcement for every user.

requirements.name: Ensure that 'Users can create Azure AD Tenants' is set to 'No'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.entra_users_cannot_create_tenants: PASS when `defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToCreateTenants` is false.

requirements.name: Ensure Access Review is Set Up for External Users in Azure AD Privileged Identity Management

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0: paged /users?$select=id,userType,accountEnabled; paged /roleManagement/directory/roleAssignmentScheduleInstances; paged /identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions, per-definition /instances and per-instance /decisions; resolve role scope, transitive group membership and excluded principals.
new_checks.predicate: For every active privileged-role assignment to a Guest (including effective group membership), PASS only when a recurring current review definition covers that role and principal and the latest due instance within the policy-approved review interval is completed and records a completed decision for that principal. FAIL for a fully measured uncovered, overdue or undecided assignment. UNKNOWN when the review interval, exclusions, role/group scope, instance state, decisions or any page is unresolved. No applicable assignments is NOT_APPLICABLE.
new_checks.title: Guest privileged role assignments receive a current access review
new_checks.description: Guest users with active privileged Entra roles need recurring, completed review decisions for their individual assignments.
new_checks.remediation_hint: In Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Access reviews, create a recurring review covering each guest privileged role; complete a decision for every assigned guest.

requirements.name: Ensure Guest Users Are Reviewed on a Regular Basis
requirements.reason: Ensure Guest Users Are Reviewed on a Regular Basis is an Azure configuration signal available from the stated read-only source; no existing evaluator tests its required fields. Resource criticality, approval, or periodic human review requires an organization-defined baseline.

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0 paged /users?$select=id,userType,accountEnabled; /identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions, each definition/instances, and each instance/decisions. Resolve scope.query against guest IDs and follow every @odata.nextLink.
new_checks.predicate: For each in-scope Guest user, require a current recurring review definition that actually includes the user and a completed in-window instance with a decision item whose principal.id is that user and whose decision is Approve, Deny or a reviewer-entered DontKnow. A generated NotReviewed item is not a completed decision. PASS only after complete guest, definition, instance and decision pages establish coverage for every guest. FAIL for a definitely uncovered guest or NotReviewed/missing decision after complete enumeration. UNKNOWN for unresolved scope, recurrence, decision status, pagination or maxReviewAgeDays. No guests is NOT_APPLICABLE.
new_checks.title: Ensure Guest Users Are Reviewed on a Regular Basis
new_checks.description: Checks that every guest account is covered by a recurring, recently completed Entra access review.
new_checks.remediation_hint: In Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Access reviews, configure a recurring guest review and complete decisions for every guest within maxReviewAgeDays.

new_checks.data_source: Collector azure.py vm items and storage_account items; VM properties.storageProfile.osDisk.vhd.uri and dataDisks[].vhd.uri are string URLs. new_checks.predicate: For each in-scope unmanaged VHD URI, FAIL if its uniquely resolved storage account explicitly has blob encryption disabled; PASS if every VHD uniquely resolves and each account has blob encryption enabled; UNKNOWN for ambiguous/unresolved URL, missing encryption field or incomplete VM/account inventory. Coverage depends on a registered evaluator and complete current identity facts; this explanation alone does not establish automated coverage.

A syntactically valid reference alone cannot PASS the broad CIS requirement.

new_checks.data_source: Graph v1.0 paged /users?$select=id,userType,accountEnabled; /identityGovernance/accessReviews/definitions, each definition/instances, and each instance/decisions. Resolve scope.query against guest IDs and follow every @odata.nextLink.

requirements.name: 9.3.1.2 Ensure that Storage Account access keys are periodically regenerated
requirements.reason: The evaluator uses a fixed 90-day age threshold for key1 and key2. The requirement says periodically; the organization’s approved rotation interval and evidence of actual key use and renewal remain to be checked.

requirements.name: 9.3.1.3 Ensure 'Allow storage account key access' for Azure Storage Accounts is 'Disabled'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.no_shared_key: PASS when `properties.allowSharedKeyAccess` is false.

requirements.name: 9.3.2.1 Ensure Private Endpoints are used to access Storage Accounts
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.claude.storage_private_link_all_approved: PASS when at least one private endpoint exists and every connection is Approved.

requirements.name: 9.3.2.2 Ensure that 'Public Network Access' is 'Disabled' for storage accounts
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.no_public_network: PASS when `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Disabled`.

requirements.name: 9.3.2.3 Ensure default network access rule for storage accounts is set to deny
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.default_deny: PASS when `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Deny`.

requirements.name: 9.3.3.1 Ensure that 'Default to Microsoft Entra authorization in the Azure portal' is set to 'Enabled'
requirements.reason: The mapped native evaluator reports azure.storage.default_oauth: PASS when `properties.defaultToOAuthAuthentication` is true.
